Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Guri]]: the obverse of a United States one-cent coin (penny) dated 1990, struck at the Denver Mint, ten years before [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] (2001) printed Guri's "Worth every decicred".

Source: [https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1990-issue_US_Penny_obverse_2.jpg 1990-issue US Penny obverse 2.jpg], Wikimedia Commons, own work by Daniel Schwen, 4 January 2007. Reduced to 960 pixels wide. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261011080245/https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:1990-issue_US_Penny_obverse_2.jpg Internet Archive], 11 October 2026.

License: [https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/ Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5] (Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015072459/https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/ Internet Archive], 15 October 2026). Attribution: Daniel Schwen. The coin design is a work of the United States Mint and is in the public domain.
